svg.aria-label: What a session gets: grants minted per session, never a platform credential
svg.title: What a session gets: grants minted per session, never a platform credential
svg.text: What a session gets: grants minted per session, never a platform credential
The session user is root in its microVM, so the kernel role holds nothing that belongs to another session or to the platform. The backend mints every credential per session.
① connect / invoke → ② warmup carries per-session grants → ③ SigV4 with the session's own STS identity → ④ gateway swaps in the LiteLLM key from its vault · revoke = IAM Deny on aws:userid
